name: param-uq-01-elongation
title: Ribosome basal elongation rate dominates growth-rate variance among effective elongation knobs (Sobol ≈ 0.97)
claim:
Among the v2ecoli elongation knobs reachable via baseline config_overrides, the
ribosome's translation basal_elongation_rate ROBUSTLY DOMINATES variance in
instantaneous growth rate — total-order Sobol ≈ 0.97 (stable across 3 PCRV
seeds, range 0.955–0.987), vs ppGpp-synthesis kS ≈ 0.04 and DNA-pol elongation
rate ≈ 0.01. The PCE surrogate fits to ~1.7% test error. This CORRECTS the
initial demo, whose "gtpPerElongation dominates (0.88)" reading was a
state-carryover artifact (fixed in v2ecoli PR #197).
question:
(1) Does the pbg-uq forward-UQ pipeline run end-to-end on v2ecoli? (2) Among the
elongation parameters that actually affect the simulation, which dominates
variance in instantaneous growth rate — and is the ranking robust across seeds?

report.title: param-uq-01-elongation — ribosome basal elongation rate dominates growth-rate variance
report.evidence_quality: order-2 PCE, n=30+10, 3 seeds (STABLE ranking), test rel-err 1.3–2.1%
report.objective:
Run a TRUSTWORTHY forward-UQ on v2ecoli — after correcting the methodological
defects found in the initial demo — to identify which elongation parameter
most drives variance in instantaneous growth rate, and confirm robustness.
report.setup:
### Parameter Specifications

Each parameter is a top-level process-config scalar reachable via
`baseline()` `config_overrides`. Bounds were screened so that only knobs with
a real effect on the observable are included (the screen %-response of
instantaneous growth rate to a low→high swing is shown).

| Parameter | Config path | Min | Max | Mid | Units | Screen % | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `basal_elongation_rate` | `ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.basal_elongation_rate` | 15 | 28 | 21.5 | aa/s | 13.8% | Ribosome elongation rate for non-ribosomal proteins (default 22). Sets how fast ribosomes add amino acids → protein-synthesis flux. Experimentally tunable via sub-inhibitory chloramphenicol. |
| `kS` | `ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.kS` | 60 | 140 | 100 | — | 5.5% | Saturation constant (default 100) in the polypeptide-elongation charging / ppGpp-synthesis kinetics (grouped with the tRNA-charging constants krta/krtf). Couples elongation to amino-acid/ppGpp state. |
| `chrom.basal_elongation_rate` | `ecoli-chromosome-replication.basal_elongation_rate` | 700 | 1200 | 950 | nt/s | 2.8% | DNA-polymerase (replisome) elongation rate (default 967); the stochastic per-step rate is drawn around this basal value. Sets chromosome-replication speed. |

Candidates screened out as INERT (≤1.4% response, excluded): `k_RelA` (1.4%),
`gtpPerElongation` (energy accounting only), `import_threshold`, `D_period`
(all 0.0%). `ribosomeElongationRate` is also config-inert (overwritten at
runtime each step → config value ignored), and is not one of the 7 screened knobs.

### Tracked Observable

| Observable | Path | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `instantaneous_growth_rate` | `listeners.mass.instantaneous_growth_rate` | The responsive growth observable. Mass observables (`dry_mass`, `cell_mass`) move <0.16% over a 120-step window — a fresh cell barely grows in ~2% of a generation — so they carry no parameter signal at this window. |

### Methodology

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Tool / reproducer | pbg-uq · `examples/v2ecoli_uq_ensemble.py` |
| Composite | `v2ecoli.composites.ecoli_baseline`; observables via `run_multigen_xarray` (XArray emitter) |
| Sampling | PCRV (uniform prior) |
| Surrogate | order-2 Polynomial Chaos Expansion, Legendre basis (10 terms), `lsq` regression |
| Sensitivity | analytic Sobol indices from PCE coefficients (Sudret 2008) |
| Budget | 30 train + 10 test per seed, **3 PCRV seeds (0, 1, 2)** for robustness |
| Window | 120 simulation steps (~4% of one generation) |
| Correctness | fresh `initial_state` per sample (v2ecoli PR #197) → samples independent; verified identical params → identical output |
report.result:
STABLE, well-determined ranking — the dominant knob is identical across all 3
PCRV seeds (argmax [0, 0, 0]); PCE test relative error 1.3–2.1%.

| Rank | Parameter | S_Ti (total, mean) | [range] | S_i (first) | Interaction | ≈ % of growth-rate variance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `basal_elongation_rate` | **0.966** | [0.955, 0.987] | 0.956 | 0.010 | **96.6%** |
| 2 | `kS` | 0.036 | [0.013, 0.057] | 0.027 | 0.009 | 3.6% |
| 3 | `chrom.basal_elongation_rate` | 0.011 | [0.008, 0.016] | 0.004 | 0.007 | 1.1% |

**Top driver:** `basal_elongation_rate` explains ≈ 96.6% of growth-rate variance
(S_Ti = 0.966), ~27× the next knob. Its first-order ≈ total-order (0.956 vs
0.966), so the effect is almost entirely DIRECT (negligible interaction).

Figures: `charts/sobol_indices.png` (Sobol bars, across-seed whiskers) and
`charts/pce_response_curves.png` (predicted growth rate vs each parameter).
report.interpretation:
The ribosome's basal elongation rate is, by a wide margin, the dominant driver
of instantaneous-growth-rate variance among the effective config-reachable
elongation knobs — Sobol ≈ 0.97, robust across sampling seeds, near-perfect
surrogate fit. This is mechanistically expected: basal_elongation_rate directly
sets ribosome speed → protein-synthesis flux → growth rate, whereas
ppGpp-synthesis kS and DNA-pol elongation rate act more indirectly and weakly on
short-window growth rate. NOTE this study CORRECTS the initial demo: its
"gtpPerElongation dominates (Sobol 0.88)" reading was an artifact of a
state-carryover bug (baseline() shared initial_state across samples → fixed in
v2ecoli PR #197), and 2 of its 3 chosen parameters were in fact inert
(ribosomeElongationRate is overwritten at runtime; gtpPerElongation only
touches energy accounting and doesn't move growth rate measurably).
report.decision:
PASS — robustly demonstrated. Among effective config-reachable elongation knobs,
translation basal_elongation_rate dominates instantaneous-growth-rate variance
(Sobol ≈ 0.97, stable across 3 seeds, ~1.7% surrogate error). See the scope
caveats for how far to generalize.

### Provenance

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Command | `python examples/v2ecoli_uq_ensemble.py` (v2ecoli .venv) |
| Date | 2026-06-12 |
| pbg-uq | 0.1.0 |
| pbg-emitters | 0.1.0 |
| pytuq | 1.0.0 |
| process-bigraph / bigraph-schema | 1.4.17 / 1.4.1 |
| numpy / scipy / polars | 2.4.5 / 1.17.1 / 1.40.1 |
| Reproducibility dependency | v2ecoli PR #197 (deep-copy initial_state) — without it, samples are not independent |

assumptions.text:
Config-reachable top-level process knobs are a meaningful (if partial)
parameter surface. The deep sim_data physiological params (kinetic rates, mass
fractions, etc.) live in the sim_data dataclass and need ParCa-level injection;
they were NOT varied here.

instantaneous_growth_rate over a 120-step window captures the elongation
parameters' effect. Longer windows / mass observables would probe slower
effects and could shift the ranking.

effective elongation knob robustly dominates: ribosome basal_elongation_rate
explains ≈96.6% of instantaneous-growth-rate variance (total-order Sobol 0.966,

study_card.goal:
Run a trustworthy forward UQ (PCRV-sampled order-2 PCE + analytic Sobol) on the
3 effective elongation knobs from param-uq-00 to identify which most drives
instantaneous-growth-rate variance, and confirm the ranking is seed-robust.
study_card.why_before_next:
Establishing a single robust dominant driver (and correcting the earlier
state-carryover artifact) is the foundation the multi-observable (param-uq-02)
and cell-cycle-stratified (param-uq-03) studies build on.

biological_summary:
Ribosome basal elongation rate sets how fast ribosomes add amino acids, directly
controlling protein-synthesis flux and therefore growth rate. The UQ confirms this
mechanism quantitatively: basal_elongation_rate dominates growth-rate variance
(Sobol ≈ 0.97), while the ppGpp/charging constant kS and the DNA-polymerase
elongation rate act more indirectly and weakly on short-window growth rate.

literature_anchors.expectation:
Ribosome basal_elongation_rate is experimentally tunable downward via
sub-inhibitory chloramphenicol, and the v2ecoli baseline value (~22 aa/s) derives
from the wcEcoli/v2ecoli mechanistic parameterization.
literature_anchors.status_in_workspace: Verified — the UQ prior brackets the documented default.

model_change.notes:
No model change — config_overrides perturb existing process-config scalars. The
external pbg-uq driver (examples/v2ecoli_uq_ensemble.py) wraps baseline() per
sample with the XArray emitter; the only correctness requirement is a fresh
initial_state per sample (v2ecoli PR #197).

implementation_requirements.title: Deep-copy initial_state per sample (v2ecoli PR
implementation_requirements.description:
Without independent initial states the buggy shared-bundle path lets dry_mass
climb by sample index, producing the spurious gtpPerElongation dominance.

design_pivot_required.question: Should the UQ reuse the original demo's 3 parameters (incl. gtpPerElongation, ribosomeElongationRate)?
design_pivot_required.decision:
NO. The param-uq-00 screen showed ribosomeElongationRate (runtime-overwritten) and
gtpPerElongation (energy-accounting-only) are inert. The UQ was redesigned to vary
only the 3 EFFECTIVE knobs, and the state-carryover bug was fixed (PR #197). This
correction — not the original 'gtpPerElongation dominates' reading — is the result.
alternatives: Keep the demo's parameters (rejected — 2 of 3 inert, and the result was a carryover artifact).

falsifiability:
The dominance claim fails if basal_elongation_rate's total-order Sobol index is
not the largest among the effective elongation knobs, or if it is not stable
across the 3 PCRV seeds (its 0.955-0.987 range would straddle the next knob,
kS ~0.04). A held-out PCRV seed or a different integration window that reordered
the ranking would refute it.

alternative_hypotheses.claim: basal_elongation_rate's apparent dominance is a single-seed / single-window sampling artifact, not a robust ranking.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminated_by: Three independent PCRV design seeds (0,1,2) on the order-2 PCE — the total-order Sobol stays 0.955-0.987 and never approaches the next knob (kS ~0.04).
